newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA'S AWB SELLS 4,000/T WHEAT IN TENDER 31.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA'S AWB SELLS 4,000/T WHEAT IN TENDER 31.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said on Tuesday it had sold 4,000 tonnes of wheat in its latest tender for domestic sales from the national pool.
Total bids were received for 72,000 tonnes.
In this, bids were for 22,000 tonnes of current season wheat and 50,000 tonnes of new crop wheat.
Lowest successful bids were priced at A$210.00 a tonne for Australian Standard White (ASW) current crop delivered Geelong and A$215.00 a tonne for new crop soft wheat delivered Geelong.
